mechanism.claim: An extreme absolute funding level marks leveraged crowding; when the completed settlement cycle also has high realized variation, its directional price displacement mean-reverts during the next cycle regardless of the funding sign.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of log(last_close[S]/first_open[P]) over [P,S)
mechanism.why_distinct: Unlike HVFADR this policy does not use funding first differences or require price/funding divergence, and unlike HVCFLR it uses funding magnitude only as a crowding regime while direction comes exclusively from fading the completed price move.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed intervening eight-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 40 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: actual funding-settlement levels and causal funding-level ranks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.previous_settlement: immediately prior actual settlement P with S-P exactly 8 elapsed hours
features.funding_level: finite nonzero funding_rate[S], used only through absolute magnitude
features.absolute_level_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(funding_rate[S]) over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.70
features.completed_return: finite nonzero log(last coherent BTCUSDT 1m close before S / first coherent BTCUSDT 1m open at P) over exactly [P,S)
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns over exactly 480 coherent BTCUSDT bars [P,S))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.eligible: the exact eight-hour gap, finite nonzero current funding level and completed return, and both ranks pass at S; no funding-sign relation, zero-cross, divergence, onset, first difference, OI, premium, alt, or post-settlement condition

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: signal settlement precedes entry; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.bars: Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no settlement gap, completed-return, history, level-rank, side, variation, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
